correctness.rationale: PASS, bounded proof verification: For every fixed k>=m and n sufficiently large, a connected k-set in C_n^m has edge boundary at least B=m(m+1) from its maximal internal-edge count. Equality sets are all m-cliques when k=m, exactly mn sets, and consecutive k-site cyclic intervals for k>=m+1, exactly n sets; other connected candidate cutsets cost at least B+2 deleted edges. A finite fixed K admits O(n) connected candidate sets and O(1) dependencies per cutset. Cutset factorial-moment clusters with overlap have at least one extra deleted edge, so their contributions vanish and independent Poisson intensities m*lambda, lambda,... result. Independently enumerated local boundary minimizers for m=2,3 and k=m,m+1,m+2, plus original verify_band.py inspected. A finite check is not the all-fixed-m proof.
